about: Labelled retrieval queries for the HR policy corpus in assets/hr_knowledge_base.json. Set A is not stored here -- it is derived at run time from each policy's own `question` field, which gives 26 query/document pairs for free. Set A is the easiest possible test, because the query was authored alongside its answer and shares vocabulary with it by construction. Set B below is the honest test: the same 26 policies, asked the way an employee would ask, deliberately avoiding the literal keyword strings. Split deterministically by index; retrieval parameters may be tuned against dev only.
split_rule: even index -> dev, odd index -> report
